description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_GetTags, which implements the getTags() method for Smarty templates. It handles retrieving tags and attributes from Smarty templates for internal processing.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetTags
classes.description: Implements the getTags() method to retrieve tags from Smarty templates.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns an array of tags and attributes used by a Smarty template object, creating and caching the tags as needed. Throws exceptions if the template cannot be loaded.
